About Helios Towers
-------------------

Helios Towers (HT) is a market-leading telecommunications infrastructure company, having established one of the most extensive tower portfolios across Africa. HT builds, owns and operates telecoms passive infrastructure, enabling mobile operators to roll out efficiently and enhance coverage, and improve network access across our markets.  
  
Founded in 2009, HT currently operates over 8,600 sites across Tanzania, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Ghana, Republic of Congo, South Africa and Senegal. Following recent acquisition agreements and subject to regulatory approvals, Helios Towers expects to establish a presence in five new markets across Africa and the Middle East over the next 12 months. Including these acquisitions and BTS site commitments, the Group’s total site count is expected to increase from over 8,500 towers currently to approaching 15,000.  
  
For more information please visit our website.

About New Motion
----------------

Bij New Motion maken we RVS transport- en handlingsystemen voor de voedingsmiddelenindustrie. Onze klanten zijn zowel voedselproducenten als machinebouwers uit Nederland, maar ook van ver daarbuiten. Wij leveren hen complete oplossingen, gebaseerd op onze eigen ideeën, engineering en assemblage.  
  
Onze systemen onderscheiden zich door het gebruik van kwalitatief hoogwaardige materialen. Zij voldoen aan alle specifieke normen en wij zetten ze met zorg en aandacht in elkaar. Waar mogelijk werken we op basis van standaardconfiguraties; dat scheelt natuurlijk productietijd en -kosten. Lukt dat niet, dan helpen we onze klanten met maatwerk.  
  
Voor complexe vraagstukken bedenken wij graag eenvoudige, robuuste oplossingen. Daarmee brengen we producten niet alleen van A naar B, maar hebben we bijvoorbeeld ook mogelijkheden op het gebied van sorteren, detecteren, doseren of richten.  
  
Wij hebben meer dan 20 jaar ervaring en alle kennis en expertise in eigen huis. Leren vinden wij belangrijk. Ook, of misschien júist wel, door de fouten die we maken. En we stimuleren onze mensen om zich te blijven ontwikkelen. Op die manier groeien we met elkaar en als organisatie. En daar zijn we trots op.  
  
Wij zijn New Motion.

Fuchsberg Law Center, located in Central Islip, New York, is a distinguished institution dedicated to providing a comprehensive legal education that emphasizes both doctrinal knowledge and practical lawyering skills. Situated within a vibrant state and federal court campus, Touro Law offers students unique opportunities to engage with the judicial system from the outset of their studies. This integration allows students to experience real courtroom dynamics, enhancing their learning through simulated and actual legal practice in classrooms, clinics, and field placements.  
  
Touro Law Center provides flexible pathways for students to earn their Juris Doctor degree, accommodating various schedules with full-time, part-time day, part-time evening, and Sunday options, as well as a hybrid FlexTime Program. This adaptability ensures that students can balance their academic pursuits with personal and professional commitments. The curriculum is designed not only to impart essential legal doctrines but also to instill a strong sense of ethical responsibility and commitment to social justice, reflecting the school’s rich tradition of community service.  
  
Graduates of Touro Law have gone on to excel in diverse fields, achieving distinction in private practice, corporate law, government positions, and public interest roles. The faculty at Touro Law, known for their dedication to teaching and mentorship, play a crucial role in shaping the next generation of legal professionals. For those interested in the faculty's expertise, a detailed Touro College Jacob D. Fuchsberg Law Center teachers list is available on their website, showcasing the accomplished scholars and practitioners who guide students through their legal education.

About Linda Greenlaw

Linda Greenlaw is a celebrated author known for her gripping, suspense-filled narratives that delve into the world of fishing and maritime adventures. With a distinct and compelling writing style, she captivates readers with her personal experiences and professional insights from her career as a commercial fisherman, captain, and author.  
  
A native of Maine, Greenlaw was born into a family deeply rooted in seafaring traditions. Growing up in this rich maritime environment nurtured her love for the ocean and forged a strong connection to the fishing industry. As a young woman, she made history by becoming the only female swordfishing captain on the East Coast. This milestone in her career paved the way for future achievements and solidified her status as a trailblazer in a male-dominated industry.  
  
Greenlaw's first-hand experiences at sea provide the foundation for her riveting and authentic storytelling. With an intimate understanding of the challenges and hardships faced by fishermen, she brings a unique perspective to her writing, painting a vivid and realistic portrait of life on the open ocean. Her keen observational skills and attention to detail breathe life into her narratives, allowing readers to immerse themselves in the visceral and often dangerous world of commercial fishing.  
  
One of Greenlaw's most notable works is "The Hungry Ocean," a memoir that offers a gripping account of her experiences as the captain of a swordfishing vessel. This captivating book provides a rare glimpse into the intense and high-stakes world of commercial fishing, exploring the physical and emotional toll of the job while showcasing Greenlaw's unwavering determination and resilience in the face of adversity. "The Hungry Ocean" received widespread critical acclaim and solidified Greenlaw's reputation as a talented and insightful author.  
  
In addition to her memoirs, Greenlaw has also penned several works of fiction that draw upon her deep knowledge of the sea and its intricacies. About Silk Street Market 秀水街
----------------------------

秀水街集团是依托“秀水街”商业品牌成立的集零售、国际贸易、物业管理、地产开发、电子商务于一体的综合性集团公司。旗下的秀水街市场是国内成型最早、知名度最高的涉外旅游市场，与改革开放相伴相生，有着三十多年的品牌积淀，目前每年客流量达1500万人次，各国贵宾、政要贵宾频繁光顾，拥有遍及全球的影响力。  
集团崇尚水文化：兼收并蓄，以纳百川，帮助员工实现个性化发展，在涓流汇成的江海中蓄势、发力，成就辉煌；厚德载物，润物无声，持续不断的为北京经济发展奉献自己的力量。  
集团在发展中建立了科学的管理模式与用人机制，致力于为每位员工提供和谐愉快的工作环境和持续上升的职业前景，让企业与人共同发展，不断进步。集团通过内部人材的潜力发掘和外部人才的引进，打造了一个创新、进取、高效、务实的集团队伍。秀水街集团携30余年品牌威名，以雄厚的资金和清晰的理念规出一个发展壮大的美好蓝图——集团现已启动全球电子商务项目，并将陆续在二、三线城市启动商业地产项目。  
在商业成功之余，秀水街集团还积极承担企业社会责任，在文化、教育等领域广泛开展社会公益项目。2009年为重庆失学女童捐款近360万；2011年开始设立的“树人奖学金”起始资金500万元，是集团回馈社会的公益平台。  
为配合集团战略发展需要，现诚招有能力、有激情、有梦想的社会各界有识之士，加入我们的团队。并将试行年收益分享计划，收益分享计划属于奖励计划，它鼓励部分或者全体员工通过共同努力来达到公司的效益目标，并且是员工和公司能够共同分享由于这种努力所产生的收益。海纳百川，有容乃大，我们坚信，每个新员工都是汇入“秀水大江海”的新支流，必将与秀水街集团一同汹涌向前。  
  
乱石穿空，惊涛拍岸，卷起千堆雪，在时代大潮中，秀水街集团以广阔的发展平台、进取的工作态度、敬业的职业准则，愿与有识之士携手，共创美好未来。

About Martha Washington

Martha Washington, the former First Lady of the United States, was a woman of great influence and grace. Born as Martha Dandridge in 1731 in New Kent County, Virginia, she was the eldest daughter of a prominent plantation owner. Martha was known for her beauty, intelligence, and strong character, which would serve her well in her future role as the nation's first First Lady.  
  
Martha married her first husband, Daniel Parke Custis, at the age of 18, and became a wealthy widow at the age of 25 when he passed away, leaving her with a substantial estate and two young children. Her widowhood did not last long, however, as she soon caught the eye of a young military officer by the name of George Washington. The two were married in 1759, and Martha moved to his estate at Mount Vernon, where she would serve as the lady of the house until George's election as the first President of the United States.  
  
As the wife of the President, Martha Washington carried out her duties with dignity and grace, setting the precedent for future First Ladies. She hosted formal dinners and receptions at the President's House in Philadelphia, as well as smaller, more intimate gatherings at Mount Vernon. Martha was known for her warm hospitality and her ability to put guests at ease, regardless of their social status or political affiliations. She also took an active interest in current events and often served as a sounding board for her husband, offering him advice and support when needed.  
  
In addition to her social obligations, Martha was also a devoted wife and mother. She and George did not have any children of their own, but she took on the role of stepmother to George's two surviving children from his first marriage. She also maintained close ties with her own children from her first marriage, even after they had grown and left the nest. Martha's nurturing and maternal nature made her a beloved figure in the Washington household and in the wider community.  
  
Throughout her time as First Lady, Martha was seen as a unifying figure, helping to bridge the gap between the various factions and parties that were emerging in the young nation. She was known to welcome guests from all walks of life, including members of the political opposition, and was always careful to remain neutral in her public statements. Her ability to navigate the complex political landscape with grace and poise earned her the respect and admiration of many, and she is still remembered as one of the most influential and beloved First Ladies in American history.  
  
After George's presidency, Martha and George retired to Mount Vernon, where they lived out their remaining years in peaceful seclusion. When George passed away in 1799, Martha was left grief-stricken but continued to uphold their legacy at Mount Vernon. She remained active in the management of the estate, overseeing the operations of the plantation and the well-being of their enslaved workers. She also took on the responsibility of preserving George's legacy, ensuring that his papers and records were organized and maintained for future generations.  
  
Martha Washington's impact on the nation extended far beyond her time in the White House. Her grace, dignity, and strength of character set the standard for future First Ladies, and her influence on the early years of the United States cannot be overstated. As a devoted wife, a caring mother, and a respected hostess, she played a crucial role in shaping the social and political culture of the young nation. Her legacy continues to be celebrated and honored, and she is remembered as a woman of great integrity and compassion.

What services does the International Refugee Assistance Project (IRAP) provide to refugees?

IRAP offers a range of services to assist refugees and people seeking safety, including direct legal services, advocacy, and policy support. Our legal aid encompasses assistance with asylum applications, refugee resettlement, family reunification, and special immigrant visas. We also provide resources for private sponsorship and humanitarian parole, ensuring that individuals have the necessary support to navigate complex legal processes.

How can I get involved with IRAP and support refugees?

There are several ways to get involved with IRAP. You can volunteer your legal expertise by providing pro bono services, participate in fundraising events, or advocate for refugee rights in your community. Additionally, you can donate to support our programs and initiatives aimed at empowering refugees and enhancing their access to legal resources. Visit our website for more information on current opportunities and initiatives.

What is the process for applying for asylum through IRAP?

The asylum application process can be complex and varies by individual circumstances. At IRAP, we guide applicants through each step, starting with an initial consultation to assess eligibility. We help prepare and file the necessary documentation, represent clients in hearings, and provide ongoing support throughout the process. It's important to act quickly, as there are deadlines for filing asylum applications, so reaching out to us as soon as possible is crucial.

Does IRAP provide legal assistance for climate-displaced individuals?

Yes, IRAP recognizes the growing impact of climate change on displacement and offers legal assistance to individuals affected by climate-related events. We work to identify complementary pathways for those displaced by climate change and advocate for policies that protect their rights. Our legal team is equipped to handle cases related to climate displacement, ensuring that affected individuals receive the support they need.

What resources does IRAP offer for refugees seeking family reunification?

IRAP provides comprehensive resources for refugees seeking family reunification, including legal guidance on the application process, eligibility requirements, and necessary documentation. We assist clients in navigating the complexities of family reunification applications, whether through refugee status or other legal avenues. Our goal is to help families reunite safely and efficiently, and we offer both direct legal services and digital resources to facilitate this process.

How does IRAP utilize legal technology to assist refugees?

IRAP leverages legal technology to enhance our services and improve access to legal resources for refugees. This includes the development of digital tools that streamline the application process, provide information on legal rights, and connect refugees with legal aid. By utilizing technology, we aim to make our services more efficient and accessible, ensuring that refugees can easily find the support they need to navigate their legal challenges.

About City of Yakima
--------------------

The City of Yakima, population 93,000 and growing, was incorporated in 1886 and is located in sunny central Washington. It encompasses 28.17 square miles in an area of rich volcanic soil. A regional getaway destination, the City is 145 miles southeast of Seattle, 200 miles southwest of Spokane, and 180 miles northeast of Vancouver, Washington. The region hub city is served by rail, highway and air transportation facilities, which have helped develop the City as the commercial and business center of Central Washington. Yakima is the 11th largest city in the State of Washington.  
  
The City of Yakima operates as a first class charter city under the Council/Manager form of government. The City provides a full range of municipal services, which include public safety (police, fire, and building safety), public improvements (streets, traffic signals), sanitation (solid waste disposal, sanitary wastewater utility), water and irrigation utilities, transit, community development, parks and recreation, and general administrative services.  
  
Tagged by locals as "The Palm Springs of Washington," the city does have a large convention center with several destination amenities such as golf, tennis, orchards, wineries, craft breweries, SunDome and Central Washington Fairgrounds, minor league baseball, and greenbelt activities along the Yakima River.

About Thomas Jefferson

Thomas Jefferson, the third President of the United States, was a man of extraordinary intellect and remarkable achievements. Born in Shadwell, Virginia in 1743, Jefferson was a true Renaissance man, with wide-ranging interests that included architecture, science, and politics. He is perhaps best known as the principal author of the Declaration of Independence, which he penned in 1776, and for his role in founding the University of Virginia. As President, he was a strong advocate for individual rights and freedoms, and his presidency was marked by significant accomplishments, including the Louisiana Purchase and the establishment of the Lewis and Clark Expedition.  
  
Jefferson’s early life was a time of privilege, but also of tragedy. His father, Peter Jefferson, was a successful planter and surveyor, and his mother, Jane Randolph, came from one of Virginia's most prominent families. However, when Thomas was just 14, his father died, leaving him and his siblings to be raised by their mother, a task she undertook with remarkable strength and dignity. Despite this loss, Jefferson received a solid education, studying under the tutelage of the Reverend James Maury and then attending the College of William and Mary, where he excelled in his studies.  
  
After finishing college, Jefferson studied law under George Wythe, one of the most distinguished lawyers in Virginia at the time. His legal studies would serve him well in his political career, as he later became known for his articulate and persuasive arguments in support of American independence and self-governance. Jefferson had great confidence in the ability of people to govern themselves, and he strongly believed in democracy and the importance of a government that was accountable to its citizens.  
  
Jefferson’s most famous achievement came in 1776 when he was asked to draft the Declaration of Independence. The document, which he wrote in just 17 days, is a masterpiece of political philosophy, expressing fundamental principles of human rights and liberty. It was a truly groundbreaking document that has had a lasting impact on not only American society, but also on the wider world. Jefferson’s eloquent writing and powerful advocacy for the rights of individuals and the need for self-government established him as a leading figure in the American Revolution and earned him a place in history as one of the country’s most influential and revered Founding Fathers.  
  
After serving as Vice President under John Adams, Jefferson was elected as the third President of the United States in 1800. His presidency was marked by significant accomplishments, including the Louisiana Purchase, which effectively doubled the size of the United States, and the establishment of the Lewis and Clark Expedition, which charted the unexplored territories of the West. Additionally, Jefferson’s presidency was marked by a commitment to limited government and reducing the national debt, goals that he achieved through a policy of fiscal restraint and frugality.  
  
Despite these achievements, Jefferson’s time in office was not without controversy. His attempt to maintain American neutrality during the escalating conflict between Britain and France, known as the Napoleonic Wars, was met with resistance from both sides, leading to strained relations with both countries. Jefferson’s embargo policies also provoked strong opposition and economic hardship, particularly in New England, leading many to question his leadership and effectiveness as President.  
  
Nevertheless, Jefferson’s contributions to American society and politics are undeniable. In addition to his work on the Declaration of Independence and his presidency, Jefferson is also remembered for his efforts to expand public education and establish the University of Virginia, which he considered one of his greatest accomplishments. True to his Enlightenment ideals, Jefferson believed that an educated populace was essential for the success of a democracy, and he dedicated considerable time and resources to the establishment of a public university that would provide a broad and liberal education to its students.  
  
Thomas Jefferson’s legacy as a statesman, philosopher, and advocate for freedom and democracy continues to resonate today. His belief in the power of human reason and his commitment to individual rights and liberties have left an indelible mark on American society and politics. Despite the complexities and contradictions of his life and career, Jefferson’s vision of a free and democratic society has continued to inspire and influence generations of Americans, reminding us of the enduring importance of his ideas and his commitment to the principles of liberty and equality.

About Pillar Biosciences Incorporated
-------------------------------------

Pillar Biosciences aims to "Make precision medicine the first option for every patient" by developing and manufacturing targeted next-generation sequencing (NGS)-based assays and software for today’s high-throughput specialty NGS laboratories.  
  
Through our SLIMamp technology (a multiplex overlapping PCR chemistry) Pillar offers a streamlined, robust and economical workflow with high mapping and on-target metrics.  
  
In conjunction with the SLIMamp assay technology, Pillar Biosciences has an informatics pipeline called the Pillar Variant Analysis Toolkit (PiVAT) that is not only highly accurate, enabling somatic variant calls down to 1% allele frequency without use of Unique Identifiers (UIDs), but also fast and efficient, returning valuable sample data quickly.  
  
For higher-sensitivity applications such as cell-free DNA analyses, Pillar Biosciences has developed a dedicated assay technology for cell-free DNA that uses UID methodology, to work with the PiVAT pipeline to drive sensitivity down to 0.1%-0.2%.  
  
Current as of May 25, 2021.

About New Holland Brewing Company
---------------------------------

New Holland exists to enhance our customers quality of life by providing the most remarkable experience possible. We strive to discover and empower an artistic approach in all aspects of our craft.  
  
Established in 1996, NHBC has grown from a scrappy two-man start-up to a thriving regional microbrewery, recognized for its creativity and artistry. We are very proud of our accomplishments thus far, and believe in earning our place in the brewing industry and in our customer’s hearts and minds everyday.  
  
All of our beer is brewed in Holland, Michigan at one of our two locations. We brew, cellar and package the main brands for distribution at our production facility on the north-side of Holland, at 690 Commerce Court. In response to our considerable growth, we opened the new brewery in October of 2006, replacing the original headquarters.  
  
We also brew beer and distill spirits in our pub. The pub is a great place for us to explore new ideas, meet our customers in a comfortable setting and provide a place of community for all who visit. The beers made here are typically special brews that rarely see their way outside of the friendly confines of our pub.  
  
In 2007, we brewed and shipped just over 7,400 barrels of beer. (A barrel = 31 gallons.)  
  
We work hard to bring you an authentic, interesting and gratifying experience.  
We are proud to share our craft with you. Hope you enjoy it as much as we do.  
  
Cheers.

About Nationale-Nederlanden
---------------------------

NN Group is an international financial services company, active in 11 countries, with a strong presence in a number of European countries and Japan. Our roots lie in the Netherlands, with a rich history of more than 175 years.  
  
With our 15,000 employees, NN Group provides retirement services, pensions, insurance, banking and investments to approximately 18 million customers. NN Group includes Nationale-Nederlanden, NN, ABN AMRO Insurance, Movir, AZL, BeFrank, OHRA and Woonnu.  
  
NN Group opened for trading on 2 July 2014 on Euronext Amsterdam under the symbol ‘NN’ after its initial public offering (IPO).  
  
For more than 175 years, our company has merged, grown and changed, but the core of who we are has remained the same. At NN Group, we put our resources, expertise, and networks to use for the well-being of our customers, the advancement of our communities, the preservation of our planet, and for the promotion of a stable, inclusive, and sustainable economy.  
  
Our purpose is to help people care for what matters most to them. Because what matters to them matters to us.

About Huntleigh Healthcare
--------------------------

As a proud member of the Arjo family, we believe that great healthcare is always a collective effort. The greatest contribution we can provide to patients, and the professionals who care for them, is confidence. This is what we have been striving for since 1979, with innovative solutions in vascular care, fetal and patient monitoring. Solutions that can assist clinicians in improving outcomes and enhancing patient wellbeing. Whether it’s the safe delivery of a new life, improving the day-to-day quality of life or monitoring life’s vital signs, we aim for clinical excellence and improved performance, for life.  
  
Huntleigh, a UK based manufacturer, is a leading global provider of innovative and high quality medical equipment for healthcare professionals. With world leading brands such as Sonicaid, Dopplex, Hydroven and Smartsigns .Huntleigh offers solutions to meet wide-ranging healthcare requirements in obstetrics, vascular assessment & treatment and patient monitoring.  
  
Huntleigh and the Sonicaid brand have been at the forefront of maternity product innovation for over 40 years, developing a world leading range of fetal Dopplers and Monitors. Complementing this range is a suite of software systems addressing every type of maternity environment, from simple single user platforms through to fully integrated installations.  
  
Combining the Hydroven IPC range with the Dopplex Vascular Assessment products provides each of our customers with a comprehensive unmatched portfolio targeting the assessment and treatment of vascular conditions. The synergy is evident through the supporting applications in both wound care and Lymphoedema management. ABI measurement is a requirement prior to the application of any form of compression therapy, the ABI can be undertaken using a Dopplex Doppler or the automatic ABI system, Dopplex Ability.  
  
Sonicaid® Dopplex® Hydroven® & Smartsigns® are registered trademarks of Huntleigh Healthcare Ltd.

What types of patient monitoring solutions does Huntleigh Diagnostics offer?

Huntleigh Diagnostics provides a range of patient monitoring solutions designed to enhance healthcare delivery. Our offerings include advanced fetal monitoring systems that ensure the safety of both mother and child during pregnancy and labor. Additionally, we offer comprehensive vascular assessment tools that help healthcare professionals monitor blood flow and identify potential vascular issues. Our solutions are tailored to meet the needs of various healthcare settings, ensuring optimal patient care.

How does Huntleigh Diagnostics support the management of lymphoedema?

Huntleigh Diagnostics specializes in lymphoedema management through innovative solutions that promote effective treatment and patient comfort. We provide a range of compression therapy products and monitoring devices that help manage symptoms and improve the quality of life for patients suffering from lymphoedema. Our solutions are designed to be user-friendly, allowing both healthcare providers and patients to effectively manage this condition.

What industries does Huntleigh Diagnostics serve?

Huntleigh Diagnostics serves a variety of industries within the healthcare sector, including hospitals, outpatient clinics, and specialty care facilities. Our products are utilized by obstetricians, vascular surgeons, and rehabilitation specialists, among others. By providing tailored solutions for different healthcare environments, we aim to enhance patient outcomes and streamline clinical workflows across the board.

Can Huntleigh Diagnostics' vascular assessment tools be integrated with other healthcare systems?

Yes, many of Huntleigh Diagnostics' vascular assessment tools are designed with interoperability in mind. Our devices can often be integrated with existing electronic health record (EHR) systems, allowing for seamless data transfer and improved clinical decision-making. This integration helps healthcare providers maintain comprehensive patient records and enhances the overall efficiency of patient care.

What training and support does Huntleigh Diagnostics provide for healthcare professionals using their products?

Huntleigh Diagnostics is committed to ensuring that healthcare professionals are well-equipped to use our products effectively. We offer comprehensive training programs, including hands-on workshops and online resources, to familiarize users with our technology and best practices. Additionally, our customer support team is available to assist with any inquiries or technical issues, ensuring that healthcare providers can deliver the best possible care to their patients.

How can I learn more about the latest innovations from Huntleigh Diagnostics?

To stay updated on the latest innovations and product offerings from Huntleigh Diagnostics, you can visit our website at http://www.huntleigh-diagnostics.com. We regularly publish news articles, product updates, and case studies that highlight our advancements in patient monitoring, lymphoedema management, and vascular assessment. About IADSS
-----------

Initiative for Analytics and Data Science Standards (IADSS) is a non-profit organization with a mission to develop and maintain professional standards in data science and data literacy.  
  
As the role of data and analytics is expanding very rapidly in creating new business models or changing existing ones, demand for analytics professionals is growing at an increasing rate. However, almost every company in the industry has a unique way of defining roles and assigning titles in data analytics related positions which has resulted in a chaotic market that is confusing to employers, academic and training institutions, and candidates; with a large number of unqualified candidates calling themselves “data scientist” or “analytics professional”.  
  
In order to address this, an initiative has been launched to conduct a research study at global scale. The study aims to gain insight about the analytics profession in the industry and help support the development of standards regarding analytics role definitions, required skills and career advancement paths.  
  
Initiative for Analytics and Data Science Standards (IADSS) will rely on the expertise of academicians and industry experts to ensure defined standards are academically sound and rooted in industry realities  
  
IADSS will also work to create awareness and promote standards globally.

What services does The Hit House offer for indie artists?

The Hit House provides a comprehensive range of services for indie artists, including music production, music supervision, and custom music creation. We help artists develop their sound, produce high-quality recordings, and navigate the complexities of music licensing and placement in various media. Our goal is to empower indie artists to reach their full potential and connect with wider audiences.

How can The Hit House assist with music supervision for my project?

Our music supervision services include selecting and licensing the perfect tracks for your project, whether it's a film, commercial, or video game. We have an extensive catalog of high-end scores and original compositions, allowing us to tailor music to fit the emotional and narrative needs of your project. Our experienced team will work closely with you to ensure that the music enhances your vision and resonates with your audience.

What types of music does The Hit House specialize in?

The Hit House specializes in a variety of music genres and styles, including commercial music, trailer music, and motion picture advertising music. Our award-winning composers and sound designers create original scores and soundscapes that are tailored to meet the specific requirements of your project, ensuring a unique and impactful auditory experience.

Can The Hit House create custom music for my advertising campaign?

Absolutely! The Hit House excels in creating custom music specifically for advertising campaigns. Our team of talented composers will work with you to understand your brand, message, and target audience, crafting original music that aligns perfectly with your campaign goals. Whether you need a catchy jingle or an emotive score, we can deliver high-quality music that enhances your advertising efforts.

What is the process for collaborating with The Hit House on a music project?

Collaborating with The Hit House is a straightforward process. First, you can reach out to us through our website to discuss your project and specific needs. We will then schedule a consultation to understand your vision and goals. After that, our team will present you with options based on your requirements, and we will work closely with you throughout the production process to ensure that the final product meets your expectations.

Does The Hit House offer services for scoring films and trailers?

Yes, The Hit House offers specialized scoring services for films and trailers. Our experienced composers are adept at creating compelling scores that enhance storytelling and evoke emotions. Whether you need a dramatic score for a feature film or an exciting soundtrack for a trailer, we can provide the expertise and creativity needed to bring your project to life.

Bayard targets three central, but separate, markets, youths up to 18 years old, seniors, and Christians — particularly Catholics.  
  
Bayard Canada's headquarters are in Montreal. The Montreal office employs more than 60 staff that work on the editorial, production, design, marketing, customer service, and distribution of the Bayard brands — including Bayard Jeunesse Canada, Bayard Canada Books, Novalis, and BND Distribution.  
  
The Toronto office employs approximately 35 staff. About The Greater Boston Food Bank
----------------------------------

The Greater Boston Food Bank (GBFB) is the largest hunger-relief organization in New England and among the largest food banks in the country. GBFB distributes over 60 million lbs of food annually, enough to provide healthy meals to more than 500,000 people who are food insecure in Eastern Massachusetts.  
  
GBFB acquires food through food industry product donations, food drives and financial contributions that enable us to purchase additional high nutrient quality food. We also benefit from the generosity of over 25,000 volunteers annually who help to sort and distribute donated food products.  
  
GBFB works to acquire, store, organize and distribute food through local food pantries, community meal programs, homeless and residential shelters, youth programs, senior centers, and day-care centers embedded in communities throughout the nine counties of eastern Massachusetts. GBFB’s food assistance locator provides an easy way for people in need to find help nearby. GBFB also distributes food directly to those in need through dedicated programs that serve particularly vulnerable groups, such as seniors and children.  
  
Since 2009, GBFB has operated out of a state-of-the-art, 117,000 square foot food distribution facility, the Yawkey Distribution Center, located in the Newmarket section of Boston.  
  
The Greater Boston Food Bank is a member of Feeding America, the nation's largest hunger-relief organization.

The board sets educational policies and guidelines for all Illinois schools both public and private. The board is responsible for making sure all schools in Illinois are catering to the needs and educational demands of students, over 2 million in the state of Illinois. The board works with the General Assembly and the Governor of Illinois to make sure that high standards and goals are not only set, but met as well.  
  
The Illinois State Board of Education is responsible for the coordination of school certification and recognition. In addition the Board makes sure that the school has an up to date license to operate. About Losango
-------------

A Losango é uma marca de propriedade do Banco Bradesco Financiamentos. Atuamos há mais de 50 anos como parceira financeira na vida de milhares de brasileiros, sempre presente nos momentos dos nossos parceiros e clientes. E pensando em quem torna nosso dia a dia possível, fomos além do físico ampliando nossa atuação para as plataformas digitais. Desenvolvemos uma experiência de parcelamento sem cartão de crédito com o nosso Boleto Parcelado Losango e aprimoramos a forma de contratação do Empréstimo Online. Tudo isso em poucos cliques!  
  
Mas o nosso propósito vai além. Aqui, na Losango, buscamos transformar sonhos em realidade, vontade em sucesso, oportunidades em conquistas, e adversidades em superações. E todo ação que tomamos tem como foco uma pessoa: você, seja parceiro ou cliente. E o slogan "A gente vai com você" reforça o nosso desejo: estar ao lado das pessoas em todos os momentos, com as melhores soluções.  
  
Muito mais que uma empresa financeira, nós trabalhamos para que você vá mais longe. Por isso, seja qual for o tamanho dos seus sonhos e objetivos, queremos fazer parte deles. Conte com a gente, sempre.

The Lisbon Accounting and Business School, commonly referred to as ISCAL, stands as a prestigious institution within the realm of higher education in Portugal. Established in 1759, ISCAL is a public school that operates under the auspices of the Polytechnic Institute of Lisbon (IPL). Located at Avenida Miguel Bombarda, 20, in the vibrant city of Lisbon, ISCAL is dedicated to fostering an environment that promotes the creation, transmission, and dissemination of culture, science, and technology.  
  
With a strong emphasis on professional education, ISCAL offers a diverse range of programs focused on administration, management, business, finance, taxation, law studies, and auditing. This comprehensive curriculum is designed to equip students with the necessary skills and knowledge to thrive in today’s competitive business landscape. The institution is committed to integrating study, research, and experimental development, ensuring that students not only learn theoretical concepts but also apply them in practical settings.  
  
Moreover, ISCAL prides itself on its distinguished faculty, comprising experienced professionals and academics who are experts in their respective fields. For those interested in exploring the teaching staff, a detailed ISCAL-Lisbon Accounting And Business School teachers list is available on their official website. This transparency reflects ISCAL's commitment to academic excellence and its dedication to providing students with high-quality education that prepares them for successful careers in various sectors. Whether you are pursuing a degree in finance, management, or law, ISCAL offers a robust educational experience that is both enriching and transformative.

What is Anaqua's AQX platform and how does it benefit IP management?

Anaqua's AQX platform is an integrated intellectual property management technology solution that combines best practice workflows with big data analytics. It offers a comprehensive suite of tools for managing patents, trademarks, and other intellectual assets. The platform enhances efficiency by automating routine tasks, providing real-time insights through analytics, and facilitating collaboration among IP teams. This results in improved decision-making, reduced operational costs, and a streamlined IP management process.

What industries does Anaqua serve with its IP management solutions?

Anaqua serves a diverse range of industries, including technology, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, consumer goods, and manufacturing. Each of these sectors has unique intellectual property needs, and Anaqua's solutions are tailored to address the specific challenges faced by organizations within these industries. By providing industry-specific tools and expertise, Anaqua helps clients effectively manage their intellectual assets and protect their innovations.

How does Anaqua's patent docketing software improve IP workflow?

Anaqua's patent docketing software streamlines the IP workflow by automating the tracking and management of patent deadlines, filings, and renewals. It provides users with customizable alerts and reminders, ensuring that critical dates are not missed. The software also integrates with other IP management tools within the AQX platform, allowing for seamless data sharing and collaboration among team members. This results in increased productivity, reduced risk of errors, and enhanced compliance with IP regulations.

Can Anaqua assist with trademark management and docketing?

Yes, Anaqua offers specialized trademark management and docketing solutions as part of its AQX platform. These tools help organizations manage their trademark portfolios efficiently, including tracking applications, renewals, and oppositions. The platform provides users with comprehensive reporting capabilities and analytics to monitor trademark performance and make informed strategic decisions. Additionally, Anaqua's trademark docketing software ensures that all critical deadlines are met, minimizing the risk of losing trademark rights.

What kind of support does Anaqua provide for patent annuities?

Anaqua provides comprehensive support for patent annuities through its technology-enabled services. This includes managing the payment of annuities, ensuring compliance with various jurisdictional requirements, and providing detailed reporting on annuity status. Anaqua's solutions help organizations optimize their annuity management processes, reduce administrative burdens, and avoid costly lapses in patent protection. Clients can rely on Anaqua's expertise to navigate the complexities of patent annuities effectively.

How does Anaqua leverage big data analytics in its IP management solutions?

Anaqua leverages big data analytics to provide actionable insights and enhance decision-making within IP management. By analyzing large volumes of data related to patents, trademarks, and market trends, Anaqua's platform helps organizations identify opportunities for innovation, assess the competitive landscape, and optimize their IP strategies. The analytics capabilities enable users to make data-driven decisions, track performance metrics, and forecast future trends, ultimately leading to more strategic management of intellectual assets.

### Frequently Asked Questions about Hitachi Zosen Inova

Who is the CEO of Hitachi Zosen Inova?

, Daniel Dreier, [Fabio Dinale](https://contactout.com/Fabio-Dinale-86081474)

What services does Hitachi Zosen Inova offer in the energy from waste sector?

Hitachi Zosen Inova (HZI) specializes in providing comprehensive solutions in the energy from waste (EfW) sector. Our services include engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) of EfW plants, as well as the design and implementation of waste combustion systems, anaerobic digestion facilities, and gas upgrading technologies. We focus on converting municipal and industrial waste into renewable energy, thereby contributing to sustainable waste management and energy production.

How does anaerobic digestion work and what are its benefits?

Anaerobic digestion is a biological process that breaks down organic matter in the absence of oxygen, producing biogas and digestate. The biogas can be used for electricity generation, heating, or upgraded to renewable natural gas. The digestate can be used as a nutrient-rich fertilizer. The benefits of anaerobic digestion include reducing landfill waste, lowering greenhouse gas emissions, producing renewable energy, and creating valuable by-products that can enhance soil health.

What industries does Hitachi Zosen Inova serve?

Hitachi Zosen Inova serves a diverse range of industries, including municipal waste management, industrial waste processing, agriculture, and energy production. Our solutions are tailored to meet the specific needs of each sector, ensuring efficient waste treatment and energy recovery. We work closely with local authorities, private waste management companies, and industrial clients to implement sustainable waste-to-energy solutions.

What is the process of gas upgrading and why is it important?

Gas upgrading is the process of purifying biogas to produce renewable natural gas (RNG) that meets pipeline quality standards. This process typically involves removing impurities such as carbon dioxide, hydrogen sulfide, and moisture. Gas upgrading is important because it allows for the utilization of biogas as a clean energy source that can be injected into natural gas grids or used as vehicle fuel, contributing to the reduction of fossil fuel dependency and greenhouse gas emissions.

Can Hitachi Zosen Inova help with retrofitting existing waste management facilities?

Yes, Hitachi Zosen Inova offers retrofitting services for existing waste management facilities to enhance their efficiency and sustainability. Our team can assess the current operations and recommend upgrades or modifications to incorporate advanced technologies such as improved combustion systems, gas upgrading solutions, and energy recovery enhancements. This helps facilities to optimize their performance and meet evolving regulatory requirements.

What are the environmental benefits of energy from waste technologies?

Energy from waste technologies provide significant environmental benefits, including the reduction of landfill waste, lower greenhouse gas emissions, and the recovery of valuable energy resources. By converting waste into energy, HZI helps to minimize the environmental impact of waste disposal while promoting a circular economy. Additionally, our technologies contribute to the reduction of reliance on fossil fuels and support the transition to renewable energy sources.

About Elicio Therapeutics
-------------------------

Elicio is committed to transforming the lives of patients and their families by re-engineering the body’s immune response to cancer. By combining expertise in materials science and immunology, Elicio is engineering potent vaccines and immuno-therapies for an array of aggressive cancers. The Elicio Amphiphile platform enables precise targeting and delivery of immunogens directly to the lymphatic system, the “brain center” of the immune response, to significantly amplify and enhance the body’s own system of defenses, to defeat cancer and stop its recurrence. This substantially enhanced anti-tumor functionality and long-term protective memory could unlock the full potential of the human immune response to eliminate cancer. Elicio's lead Amphiphile vaccines targeting pancreatic, colorectal, and head and neck cancer will begin initial patient studies in early 2020. Elicio was founded to expand and apply the ground-breaking Amphiphile technology invented and developed in the labs of Darrell Irvine Ph.D., Professor of Biological Engineering and Materials Sciences and Howard Hughes Investigator, at the Koch Institute for Integrative Cancer Research at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. Preclinical studies have demonstrated that Elicio’s Amphiphile vaccines target and concentrate in the lymph nodes resulting in unprecedented tumor-specific immune responses and durable cures of aggressive tumor models in mice.

About Continental Clothing UK
-----------------------------

Continental Clothing Company Limited is a multi-award winning manufacturer and direct wholesale distributor of ready-to-print T-shirts, sweatshirts, young fashion and childrenswear since 1994. It became incorporated in England and Wales in 1998. The Company was the innovator of the fitted T-shirt for the European music industry, and from those roots it continues to lead the way in terms of innovation and design. The focus has always been and will continue to be on creating high quality, expertly styled garments for markets such as fashion retail, music merchandise, leisure and corporate promotions.  
  
The Company owns four unique brands – Continental®, EarthPositive®, Salvage® and Fair Share™ – that are among the most up-to-date wholesale blank T-shirt brands in the world. The Company strives to provide the consumer with stylish, quality and value products that are fit for purpose.  
  
Continental Clothing Co. takes particular care with regard to the social, economic and environmental impacts of its production, throughout the supply chain – from the cotton field and raw materials through to final delivery. The Company publishes annually a detailed social report accounting for all its activities in the supply chain. It places great value on its relations with the suppliers, and works closely with them to ensure good, mutually beneficial, long-term cooperation.  
  
Over the last 12 years, Continental Clothing Co. acquired a reputation for its pioneering work in the field of sustainable clothing manufacture, covering the work on traceability, advocating the banning of child labour in the Uzbekistani cotton industry, supporting organic cotton farming, reducing the carbon footprint of its products by 90%, the development of a state-of-the-art clothing factory in India, and others.  
  
The Fair Share living wage project implemented in January 2016 and the “fighting period poverty” free sanitary pads scheme started in September 2017 are the latest additions to that list.

About LifeForce Yoga Healing Institute
--------------------------------------

LifeForce Yoga is intentionally designed to work with and manage the mood. The practices support students in self-regulation and many of the yoga techniques can be done in a chair, in bed, and do not require a yoga mat. LifeForce Yoga interweaves the power of an ancient discipline with current scientific findings to help you release what’s no longer serving you—without a story attached!  
  
Founder, Amy Weintraub’s journey towards recovery from her own mood disorder began in 1970 with a daily meditation practice. In 1989 she began to practice Kripalu Yoga, and it was that daily embodied practice joined to the breath that freed her from depression. Since then, she has studied with Yoga masters and meditation teachers in the U.S. and India and done extensive research to develop a practice that weaves ancient Classical and Tantric practices with current scientific understanding of their benefits and contraindications.  
  
No matter your lineage or the yoga “style” in which you practice, LifeForce Yoga can offer you strategies to enhance your mood without changing your basic practice. The daily practice of LifeForce Yoga will diminish your sense of separation, which is the literal source of depression. The connection you feel to that which is most authentic within you and your connection to others will be enhanced.  
  
LifeForce Yoga is a practice of compassion that creates a big enough container to embrace and accept all the dualities of mood. The practice is adapted to the student, so each individual can move into a balanced emotional, mental, and physical state of equanimity and self-awareness.

P-ai (pronounced as “pie”) is a project-based organization exploring and democratizing the interdisciplinary applications of artificial intelligence.  
  
P-ai is building the modern incubator for AI projects and ideas—filling the gap in the state of AI/ML in our current undergrad education, enabling students to engage in the the ever-expanding field of artificial intelligence, with numerous cross-functional applications in autonomous driving, supply chain, healthcare, finance, and the social sciences.  
  
Our core initiative is Project Teams: each project team will learn data preprocessing and analytics as well as the iterative design workflow for modeling unique solutions to problems of interest.  
  
P-ai also hosts accessible workshops to develop a professional Machine Learning skillset and discussion groups to examine the latest research/applications and their respective ethical implications, in which students will acquire a breadth of knowledge beyond enhancing technical competencies.  
  
P-ai will strive to establish a culture of proactive curiosity-driven learning in addition to practicing interdisciplinary communication. Ultimately, P-ai’s approach will offer a framework of informed decision-making in the age of information beneficial to all careers.

Headquartered in Eugene, OR, BHS is a worldwide leader in the innovative design, engineering, manufacturing and installation of sorting systems and components for the solid waste, recycling, waste-to-energy, and construction and demolition industries. Wholly-owned subsidiaries include Nihot (Amsterdam), NRT (Nashville, TN) and Zero Waste Energy (Lafayette, CA). BHS is also the home of Max-AI® technology, a breakthrough artificial intelligence that identifies materials, makes intelligent decisions and directs equipment such as robotic sorters. Clients around the globe choose BHS because of its experience, dedication to cutting-edge technology, quality construction and durability, and unmatched customer service. BHS has built some of the largest and most durable MRFs in the world – and they are achieving the highest throughput, recovery, and purity rates in the industry.  
  
Vision. Innovation. Collaboration  
  
BHS leads the industry in technology innovation, holding numerous patents for equipment and system designs. BHS’ commitment to innovative design and engineering, quality manufacturing, exceptional customer service, timely delivery and long-lasting, efficient systems contribute to the company’s strong reputation and success.

About Audio Network
-------------------

Audio Network is the music company for broadcasters, brands, creators and music fans everywhere, breaking down boundaries to deliver music seamlessly across the world.  
  
The company first disrupted the market landscape in 2001 with a unique proposition: simple and transparent licensing allowing creators to use music on multiple platforms, everywhere, forever.  
Audio Network now has an expansive catalogue of 150,000+ wholly-owned tracks created by 1,000+ renowned composers, singer-songwriters and known and emerging artists. These are curated into albums and playlists across every imaginable mood and genre. At the same time, regular recording sessions take place at some of the world’s best studios (including 150+ yearly sessions at Abbey Road Studios), enabling us to stay true to our brand promise of music of unrivalled quality. Since its inception 17 years ago, the business has grown exponentially. In fact, The Sunday Times lists Audio Network as one of the UK’s fastest growing companies (Tech Track 2011-2013; Profit Track 100 2013- 2015; SME Export track 2015; Les Champions de la Croissance 2017), and most acclaimed, having won the Queen’s Prize for Enterprise in 2018 (following previous wins of the 2008 Queen’s Award for Innovation and the 2012 Queen’s Award for International Trade).  
The company constantly invests in its people, its music and its clients, with offices in London (HQ), Los Angeles, New York, Paris, Toronto, Amsterdam, Sydney, Munich and Tokyo, and a staff of more than 150, including dedicated music consultants and experts. Under the leadership of CEO Robb Smith, and the guidance of our original founders Robert Hurst and Andrew Sunnucks, that model remains at the heart of the business as the company enters a new phase of expansion. Now we deliver music to the rest of the world with the same simple commitment: high-quality music, clear and simple licensing and seamless, innovative service.  
  
Discover our world-class catalogue at www.audionetwork.com.

About GovSpend
--------------

The only database of its kind, companies use our spending and PO database to see the full scope of what federal, state, local, and education organizations have purchased. Companies use this information to see which products and services agencies have purchased, how much, from which company, and related contact information about that agency.  
  
How do we collect this data?  
Over nearly a decade, we’ve created processes and relationships with agencies where we collect purchasing records in the form of POs directly from agencies. This process requires a large team of dedicated data acquisition specialists, data engineers, and developers in combination with patented technology we’ve developed to aggregate, process, and normalize the data. No one else has this data for all levels of government, nationwide.  
  
Our mission is to help procurement professionals make better purchasing decisions and find potential leads. We collect and provide access to critical purchasing data that enables the overall purchasing process to be much more efficient. Bottom line: our product does two great things at once – it saves the government millions of dollars and helps government vendors become more profitable.

About Grupo NotreDame Intermédica
---------------------------------

O Grupo Hapvida NotreDame Intermédica é, hoje, a maior operadora de saúde do Brasil, com mais 15 milhões de beneficiários de saúde e odontologia. Fruto da fusão entre o Sistema Hapvida, que começou suas operações em 1979 com a inauguração do Hospital Antonio Prudente, e a NotreDame Intermédica, fundada em 1968 e pioneira em Medicina Preventiva no País, oferece saúde integral e odontologia por meio de mais de 767 pontos de atendimento próprios, dentre eles hospitais, maternidades, unidades de pronto atendimento, clínicas, unidades de diagnóstico por imagem e coleta laboratorial (Notrelabs). Tudo isso ao alcance dos nossos beneficiários, nas cinco regiões do país: Norte, Nordeste, Centro-Oeste, Sudeste e Sul.

What services does ZoneIn CBD offer?

ZoneIn CBD specializes in providing high-quality CBD products, including oils, edibles, topicals, and capsules. What industries does ZoneIn CBD support?

ZoneIn CBD supports a variety of industries, including health and wellness, beauty and skincare, and pet care. Our products are designed to meet the needs of consumers looking for natural alternatives for health management, as well as businesses seeking to incorporate CBD into their offerings. Choosing the right CBD product depends on your individual needs and preferences. Please note that products must be unopened and in their original packaging to qualify for a return.

Does ZoneIn CBD offer educational resources about CBD?

Yes, ZoneIn CBD is committed to educating consumers and businesses about CBD. About Aileen Quinn

Aileen Quinn is an American actress and singer who captured the hearts of audiences worldwide with her captivating performances and undeniable talent. From her breakout role as the plucky orphan Annie to her continued success in both film and theater, Quinn has proven herself to be a versatile and accomplished artist.  
  
Born on June 28, 1971, in Yardley, Pennsylvania, Aileen Quinn showed an early interest in performing arts. At the age of seven, she auditioned for the role of Annie in the 1982 film adaptation of the beloved Broadway musical. Quinn's audition stood out among hundreds of hopeful young actresses, and she won the role that would catapult her into stardom. Her portrayal of the spunky redhead with a heart full of dreams and optimism received critical acclaim, earning her a Golden Globe nomination for Best Actress in a Motion Picture—Comedy or Musical.  
  
Quinn's performance in "Annie" showcased her natural talent for singing and acting. Her powerful voice, filled with youthful exuberance, brought classics like "Tomorrow" and "It's the Hard-Knock Life" to life. Her infectious energy and undeniable charisma endeared her to audiences of all ages, making her an instant favorite among young viewers and adults alike.

About Edwards Lifesciences
--------------------------

Edwards Lifesciences (NYSE: EW), is the global leader in patient-focused medical innovations for structural heart disease, as well as critical care and surgical monitoring. We thrive on discovery and expanding the boundaries of medical technology, serving patients in 100+ countries, with the help of our employees in areas including Clinical Affairs, Quality Engineering, Research & Development, Regulatory Affairs, Sales & Marketing, corporate functions and more.  
  
Our roots date back to 1958 when Miles Lowell Edwards, a retired engineer with a background in hydraulics and fuel pump operations, set out to build the first artificial heart. Edwards believed the heart could be mechanized and was encouraged by Dr. Albert Starr to focus on developing an artificial heart valve. After just two years, the first Starr-Edwards mitral valve was developed and successfully placed in a patient. This innovation spawned Edwards Laboratories. Miles’ fascination with healing the heart and helping patients with heart disease stemmed from his own experience with rheumatic fever as a teenager and continues to fuel our patient-first culture today.  
  
Today, we are as passionate about providing innovative solutions for people fighting cardiovascular disease as we have ever been. It's our Credo. It takes integrity, collaboration, innovation, and focus. We are leaders in the design and manufacture of tissue replacement heart valves and repair products as well as advanced hemodynamic monitoring. We partner with physicians to innovate products designed to help patients live longer, healthier, and more productive lives.  
  
Our work is both rewarding and a privilege. The importance of what we do defines our approach. We work together to create an environment where ideas can flourish and we provide our people with the resources, expertise and support to bring those ideas to life.  
  
For our legal terms and trademarks, please visit: https://www.edwards.com/legal/legal-terms

About The Delta Chi Fraternity, Inc.
------------------------------------

Delta Chi (ΔΧ) is an international Greek letter college social fraternity formed on October 13, 1890, at Cornell University, initially as a professional fraternity for law students. On April 29, 1922, Delta Chi became a general membership social fraternity, eliminating the requirement for men to be studying law, and opening membership to all areas of study. On April 22, 1929 Delta Chi became the first international fraternity to abolish "hell week". Delta Chi is a charter member of the North-American Interfraternity Conference (NIC). The Fraternity is headquartered at 3845 N Meridian St in Indianapolis, Indiana 46208, as of fall 2021, Delta Chi has initiated over 126,000 members and has 113 member organizations and more than 30 alumni chapters currently operating.

About Shared Services For Credit Unions
---------------------------------------

Where we started...  
Florida Credit Union Shared Services (FCUSS), Inc. was incorporated in 1992. The network began operations in 1995 with the goals to enhance the convenience, delivery and accessibility of financial services for credit union members through a statewide shared services network as well as providing a gateway to the national network. In its 1st year FCUSS processed more than 40,000 transactions with 30 participating credit unions.  
  
How we've grown...  
The Florida Network is owned by 33 credit union shareholders governed by a 9 member Board of Directors. In its 21st year, 2013, FCUSS processed more than 10.5 million transaction with 363 branch locations and 74 participating Florida credit unions 120 cities within the state of Florida. It looks to be another year of growth despite the credit union industry challenges we've seen over the years.  
  
Our way of keeping up with a changing landscape...  
SHARED SERVICES FOR CREDIT UNIONS is FCUSS’ new DBA name starting January 1st, 2015. We've changed our name in order to enhance our position in the industry. Our primary product will continue to be shared branching. Our top goal is to provide our participants, value products and services that help meet their member’s financial needs.  
Through Shared Services for Credit Unions, a participating credit union can serve their members financial service needs where they live, work or travel. By sharing branches among participating credit unions, members can conveniently enjoy "once a member - always a member." Through national connectivity, members can complete transactions as if it were their own branch at thousands of Shared Branch locations and CU Service Centers across the nation, as well as internationally.

What services does Cogito Corp offer for contact centers?

How does Cogito's Emotion AI technology work?

Cogito's Emotion AI technology analyzes vocal tone, speech patterns, and emotional cues in real-time to assess the emotional state of both agents and customers during conversations. This data is used to provide immediate coaching to agents, helping them to adapt their approach and improve customer interactions, ultimately leading to better outcomes.

What industries can benefit from Cogito's solutions?

What is the role of behavioral analytics in Cogito's platform?

Behavioral analytics in Cogito's platform helps identify patterns in agent and customer interactions. By analyzing these patterns, we can provide insights into agent performance, customer sentiment, and overall interaction quality. This information is crucial for supervisors to make informed decisions, improve training programs, and enhance the overall customer experience.

Cogito takes data privacy and security very seriously. We comply with industry standards and regulations, including GDPR and CCPA, to protect customer data. ### Frequently Asked Questions about Hard Candy Shell

What services does Hard Candy Shell offer?

Hard Candy Shell provides a range of services focused on creating exceptional digital experiences. Our specialties include User Experience Design, Digital Strategy, UX Prototyping, iOS development, Interaction Design, Front-End Development, UI Design, and Visual Design & Branding. We collaborate with brands to ensure their digital products are not only functional but also engaging and user-friendly.

How does Hard Candy Shell approach User Experience Design?

At Hard Candy Shell, we believe that User Experience (UX) is at the heart of any successful digital product. Our approach involves thorough research and understanding of user needs, behaviors, and pain points. We utilize techniques such as user personas, journey mapping, and usability testing to inform our design decisions. Our goal is to create intuitive and enjoyable experiences that resonate with users and drive engagement.

Can Hard Candy Shell assist with mobile app development?

Yes, Hard Candy Shell specializes in iOS development, among other platforms. We work with brands to design and build mobile applications that are not only visually appealing but also optimized for performance and usability. Our team ensures that the app experience is seamless across devices, providing users with a consistent and engaging interaction.

What industries does Hard Candy Shell serve?

Hard Candy Shell has experience working with a diverse range of industries, including technology, e-commerce, healthcare, education, and entertainment. Our adaptable approach allows us to tailor our services to meet the unique needs of each industry, ensuring that we deliver effective solutions that align with our clients' goals and target audiences.

How does Hard Candy Shell ensure the quality of its digital products?

Quality assurance is a critical part of our process at Hard Candy Shell. We implement a rigorous testing phase that includes usability testing, performance testing, and cross-browser compatibility checks. Our team also gathers feedback from real users to identify areas for improvement. This iterative process helps us refine our products, ensuring they meet high standards of quality and user satisfaction.

What is the process for collaborating with Hard Candy Shell?

Collaborating with Hard Candy Shell begins with an initial consultation to understand your project goals and requirements. We then conduct research and analysis to inform our strategy. Throughout the design and development phases, we maintain open communication with our clients, providing regular updates and opportunities for feedback. Our goal is to create a partnership that fosters creativity and innovation, resulting in a final product that exceeds expectations.

About Sheppard Robson
---------------------

Sheppard Robson is an ever-evolving collective of architects, interior designers and masterplanners. Together our team of 370 people design buildings, spaces and places that are people-centred and precision-made. Our family includes our interior design specialists ID:SR and AXIS, which applies our detailed design expertise to major projects by others.  
  
From our offices in London, Manchester and Glasgow, we work on a scale, and with a legacy of expertise, that means we can engage with society’s most pressing challenges. The most urgent of these is the need to achieve a better balance between humans and nature on our planet of limited resources. With no single solution, the mitigation of climate change can only be achieved with the critical application of an inventive, multi-layered approach, and by fundamentally rethinking how we live, learn, work and play.  
  
Our work is the result of creative, technical and intellectual exchange. People-centred design comes out of an engagement process where architects enable, listen and interpret as well as lead. With a robust methodology for testing ideas, we are able to fine-tune them without losing their pioneering spirit. Every project we make presents the opportunity to push our learning a little further, but we never forget that innovation should always be in the service of a clear purpose – to design for life.

About Foxconn
-------------

Established in Taiwan in 1974, Hon Hai Technology Group (Foxconn) (2317: Taiwan) is the world’s largest electronics manufacturer. Foxconn is also the leading technological solution provider, and it continuously leverages its expertise in software and hardware to integrate its unique manufacturing systems with emerging technologies. By capitalizing on its expertise in Cloud Computing, Mobile Devices, IoT, Big Data, AI, Smart Networks, and Robotics / Automation, the Group has expanded not only its capabilities into the development of electric vehicles, digital health and robotics, but also three key technologies –AI, semiconductors and new-generation communications technology – which are key to driving its long-term growth strategy and the four core product pillars: Consumer Products, Enterprise Products, Computing Products and Components and Others. In 2021, Hon Hai's annual revenue reached NT$5.99 trillion.  
  
The company has established R&D and manufacturing centers in other markets around the world including China, India, Japan, Vietnam, Malaysia, Czech Republic, U.S. and more. With a focus on research and development, the company owns more than 54,253 patents. In addition to maximizing value-creation for customers who include many of the world’s leading technology companies, Foxconn is also dedicated to championing environmental sustainability in the manufacturing process and serving as a best-practices model for global enterprises.  
  
The company has received widespread international accolades and recognition since its establishment. The company ranked 22nd on the Fortune Global 500 rankings in 2021 and 25th in the Top 100 Digital Companies in the Forbes ranking of the World’s Best Employers in 2019. Moreover, on Forbes’ World’s Best Employers 2021 rankings, the company ranked 1st in Taiwan. Foxconn is also the only Taiwanese private company awarded for 5 consecutive years of Clarivate Top 100 Global Innovators (2018 - 2022).

What is ExaGrid's Tiered Backup Storage and how does it work?

ExaGrid's Tiered Backup Storage is a unique approach that combines a disk-cache Landing Zone with a long-term retention repository. The Landing Zone allows for fast backups, restores, and instant VM recoveries, while the long-term retention repository is optimized for storing data over extended periods. This tiered architecture ensures that frequently accessed data is quickly available, while less frequently accessed data is stored efficiently, reducing costs and improving performance.

How does ExaGrid's deduplication technology enhance backup efficiency?

ExaGrid employs advanced deduplication technology that significantly reduces the amount of data that needs to be stored. By identifying and eliminating duplicate data before it is written to disk, ExaGrid minimizes storage requirements and speeds up backup processes. This means that businesses can achieve faster backups and restores, while also saving on storage costs, making their backup operations more efficient.

What industries can benefit from ExaGrid's backup storage solutions?

ExaGrid's backup storage solutions are designed to support a wide range of industries, including healthcare, finance, education, and government. Any organization that requires reliable data protection and fast recovery options can benefit from ExaGrid's offerings. The solutions are particularly valuable for industries that deal with large volumes of sensitive data and have stringent compliance requirements.

Can ExaGrid replace traditional tape libraries?

Yes, ExaGrid can effectively replace traditional tape libraries. With its disk-based backup storage solutions, ExaGrid provides faster access to data, improved recovery times, and reduced operational costs compared to tape libraries. The long-term retention capabilities of ExaGrid also ensure that organizations can store data securely for compliance and regulatory purposes without the inefficiencies associated with tape storage.

What disaster recovery options does ExaGrid offer?

ExaGrid offers comprehensive disaster recovery solutions that include replication and data recovery features. Organizations can replicate their backup data to a secondary ExaGrid system at a remote location, ensuring that they have a reliable copy of their data in case of a disaster. This allows for quick recovery and minimal downtime, helping businesses maintain continuity in the face of unexpected events.

How does ExaGrid ensure data security during backup and storage?

ExaGrid employs multiple layers of security to protect data during backup and storage. This includes encryption of data both in transit and at rest, access controls to restrict unauthorized access, and regular security audits to identify and address potential vulnerabilities. Additionally, ExaGrid's architecture is designed to prevent data loss and ensure data integrity, providing organizations with peace of mind regarding their backup data.

We then develop customized strategies that include data backup solutions, failover systems, and regular testing to ensure your business can quickly recover from any disruption, minimizing downtime and data loss.

Can Möbius Partners assist with cloud integration and migration?

Yes, Möbius Partners specializes in cloud integration and migration services. We help businesses transition to cloud-based solutions seamlessly, ensuring that your data and applications are securely migrated and fully operational in the cloud environment. Our team provides ongoing support and optimization to maximize the benefits of your cloud investment.

What cybersecurity measures does Möbius Partners offer?

Möbius Partners offers a comprehensive suite of cybersecurity solutions designed to protect your organization from evolving threats. Our services include security assessments, network access control, vulnerability management, and incident response planning. We work closely with your team to implement best practices and ensure compliance with industry standards, safeguarding your data and systems.

What is vCIO and how can it benefit my organization?

A vCIO, or Virtual Chief Information Officer, is a service provided by Möbius Partners that offers strategic IT leadership without the need for a full-time executive. Our vCIOs work with your organization to align technology with business goals, optimize IT investments, and develop long-term strategies for growth and innovation. This service is particularly beneficial for small to mid-sized businesses looking to enhance their IT capabilities without the overhead of a full-time CIO.

By promoting a culture of respect, inclusivity, and ambition, John Flamsteed Community School not only prepares students for academic success but also equips them with the skills necessary for lifelong learning and responsible citizenship. What began as a small 3,700 sq. ft. shop with less than 25 people dedicated to producing stainless steel products (SSP) in Burbank, California has evolved into the world’s largest aerospace high pressure ducting facility, Senior Aerospace SSP. Located in Burbank, a short distance from the original Lockheed P-38 Lighting Assembly line, Senior Aerospace SSP, specializes in designing, manufacturing, and qualifying complex ducting systems for aerospace applications. Since its humble roots in 1945, the campus has now expanded to include a 59,000 sq. ft high-volume production facility, in addition to its legacy 131,000 ft2 main buildings which combined, accommodate over 500 employees. Vertically integrated with its own foundry, fabrication shop, and ISO certified engineering lab, Senior Aerospace SSP acquired by Senior PLC in 1995 and has continued its expansion into new programs and technologies.
